lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular clusters are arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The clusters exhibit a high contrast against the darker grey-purple background of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient where the dorsal light source creates a highlight above and a shadow below the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast elongated object with a reflective white trailing edge is visible below the pectoral fin, likely representing a commensal organism rather than an anatomical feature of the shark.
